entities.summary: Pieter Anthonie Roelofsen was a Dutch rower. He competed at the 1932 Summer Olympics in the coxless pairs, together with Godfried Roëll, and finished fourth, 0.2 seconds behind the third place. Roëll and Roelofsen won the European title in 1931.
